catalog_name: Woodworker Express - selected Blum cabinet hardware
price_basis: Public web prices checked without signing in; account pricing may differ.
scope: 50 selected Blum soft-close screw-on hinges, CLIP mounting plates, TANDEM 563H/563F and MOVENTO 763H/769 slide lengths, locking devices and selected slide accessories. Not the entire supplier catalog.
integration_rules: Use supplier_sku as the vendor-specific primary key. Preserve all part numbers and SKU values as text; do not strip punctuation, spaces or handedness.
base_unit_price_usd is the cost of one unit as defined by unit. A slide pair contains a left and right runner; order one pair per drawer, not two.
Each locking-device SKU is one handed clip. A complete drawer needs one left and one right of the same compatible family. TANDEM and MOVENTO clips are separate systems.

Quantity tiers contain only explicitly published discounts. Empty tiers means none was displayed, not a guarantee that no other discount exists. Use base price below the first tier. Evaluate tiers per exact supplier SKU after aggregating the intended purchase quantity; do not combine unrelated parts.
All selected SKUs are sold in multiples of one priced unit. Recheck supplier unit and order_multiple when adding future products. Screws sold in packs require different purchase-rounding logic.

COMPACT hinges include their plate; CLIP top hinges require one compatible separately priced mounting plate per hinge. Door hinge count must be a chosen or engineered input based on door size and weight, not always two.

Hinge/plate geometry is a separate validated design rule. 175H5030.21 is a 9 mm inset face-frame adapter requiring a half-cranked hinge such as 71B3650, rather than automatically pairing every inset plate with 71B3750.
563H is the default for the user's 1/2-inch drawer sides. 563F is an optional thicker-box family; never silently swap H and F to obtain a cheaper price.

Rear mounting hardware depends on installation. Include two TANDEM 295.3750.02 brackets only when that mounting method is chosen. MOVENTO needs its own validated mounting method; 769 requires side mounting to frameless or blocked-out cabinets.

MOVENTO 298.7600 is one set per inset drawer, containing right and left add-on depth adjusters, per the Blum MOVENTO guide. It is included in MOVENTO inset example assemblies. It is not for TIP-ON BLUMOTION.
MOVENTO thin-front spacer T59.K010M is individually priced. Require the installation construction to determine spacer use, quantity and setback; do not auto-add to every 1/2-inch drawer.

Recipes are hardware-cost examples using base prices, not sale prices or full installed drawer costs. Store freight, tax, labor and markup as separate quote inputs. Reprice parts independently and recalculate assemblies from their components.
Treat this as an editable dated price snapshot. Recheck current prices before placing orders or issuing a binding quote.
